codes.name: Bones, joints and muscles
codes.definition: The message asks about pain, injury, or a condition of the bones, joints, muscles, back, or neck. Includes knee, back, neck, foot, and elbow pain, arthritis, osteoporosis, bone density and fracture risk, and bony lumps.
signs: names a joint, limb, back, or neck as the site of pain or injury
mentions arthritis, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, fractures, or bone density (DEXA) results
pain after walking, exercise, lifting, or an injury
asks what kind of joint or muscle injury something is
codes.how_it_differs: Bones, joints and muscles covers pain arising from bones, joints, muscles, and the spine. Headaches and nerve pain covers headaches and pain described as nerve-related (for example neuropathy). If the message names neuropathy or nerve pain, use Headaches and nerve pain even if the pain is in a limb; if it describes joint, back, or muscle pain without naming nerves, use Bones, joints and muscles. Chest and abdominal pain are not part of this code.

examples.quote: what kind of knee injury does this sound like
i developed a sharp pain in my neck that raidates to my shoulders suddenly
symptoms of osteoarthrits

codes.merge_note: All three passes had this code with the same name and near-identical scope. Pass 3 also included nerve pain felt in a limb (66d9e5be); the merged definition follows passes 1 and 2 and sends named nerve pain to Headaches and nerve pain.

codes.name: Stomach and digestion
codes.definition: The message asks about the stomach, bowel, anus, or other parts of the digestive tract. Includes stomach aches, belly or abdominal pain, gastritis, and anal or perianal problems such as fistulas.
signs: stomach ache, tummy ache, or belly pain
names a digestive condition such as gastritis
pain or symptoms when using the bathroom
anal or perianal problems such as a fistula or perianal abscess
codes.how_it_differs: Stomach and digestion is about a problem located in the digestive tract. Infections and acute illness is about sudden, whole-body illness or infection in general (fever, chills, body aches). If the main subject is a gut or anal problem, use Stomach and digestion even if infection is mentioned (an infection may be a secondary topic); if the message is about feeling generally ill or about infections in general, use Infections and acute illness. Weight and diet goals belong to Diet, weight and fitness.

examples.quote: I've been dealing with some bad stomach aches for the past few weeks.
Could it be gastritis? Tell me what causes gastritis and how long it can last.
please list every disease where fistula-in-anu is a symptom

codes.merge_note: All three passes had this code. Pass 3 named it 'Digestive and abdominal organs' and widened it to kidneys and liver to hold one pasted ultrasound report (6a638cf5); passes 1 and 2 left that message uncoded. The merged code keeps the narrower digestive-tract scope used by two passes; kidney/urinary messages are flagged in the notes.

codes.name: Skin, hair and allergies
codes.definition: The message asks about the skin, scalp, or hair, or about allergic reactions. Includes eczema, hives, flaking or scabbing scalp, hair growth or loss, and allergies to foods or medicines such as antibiotics.
signs: names a skin condition such as eczema, hives, or a rash
scalp flaking or scabbing, or hair growth or hair loss
asks about an allergic reaction or allergy to a food or drug
codes.how_it_differs: Skin, hair and allergies covers surface skin and hair problems and allergic reactions. Infections and acute illness covers infections and short-term whole-body illness. An abscess or infection under the skin goes to Infections and acute illness (or the affected organ system); a rash, hives, or allergic reaction goes here. Hair changes while on a weight-loss drug go here, with Diet, weight and fitness as an optional secondary topic.

examples.quote: What does it mean if I have eczema dry spots on my skin
My scalp is flaking and scabbing
Can an allergic reaction appear slowly

codes.merge_note: All three passes had this code; pass 2 named it 'Skin and allergies' but its definition also included hair. Name taken from passes 1 and 3.

codes.name: Infections and acute illness
codes.definition: The message asks about an infection or a sudden, short-term illness. Includes flu-like or cold symptoms (fever, chills, body aches, congestion), named infectious diseases such as hand foot and mouth disease, and questions about whether something is an infection.
signs: sudden onset of feeling unwell with fever, chills, or body aches
asks what illness they caught or whether it is the flu
names an infectious disease or asks about infections in general
asks about an abscess or whether something is infected
codes.how_it_differs: Infections and acute illness is about infection or sudden whole-body illness. If an infection is clearly located in one body system that has its own code (for example a perianal abscess), use that system's code as primary and this code as secondary, or vice versa depending on which the message centres on. A headache on its own goes to Headaches and nerve pain; a headache that is one of several flu-like symptoms goes here. Tiredness that is part of a sudden flu-like illness goes here, not to Sleep and fatigue.

examples.quote: Today I suddenly started feeling bad, fatigue, body aches, felt hot, later had the chills, nose is congested. What did I catch?
What if hand foot and mouth isn't treated
can infections of some sort smell like onions

codes.merge_note: All three passes had this code with the same name and examples. Pass 3 also put the two headache messages here because it had no headache code; the merged code follows passes 1 and 2, which kept headaches separate.

codes.name: Diet, weight and fitness
codes.definition: The message asks about nutrition, body weight, exercise, or fitness goals. Includes healthy eating, protein and supplements for fitness, normal or ideal weight, fat loss, workouts, and weight-loss medicines such as GLP-1 drugs.
signs: asks about healthy foods, meal plans, or protein intake
asks about normal or ideal weight, or losing fat or weight
mentions workouts, exercise, or fitness goals
mentions a GLP-1 or weight-loss medicine such as Zepbound
codes.how_it_differs: Diet, weight and fitness is about lifestyle goals around eating, weight, and exercise. Diabetes and hormones is about a diagnosed or suspected hormone or metabolic condition (diabetes, A1c, cholesterol, hormone imbalance). If the message is about diet or supplements to treat a named condition, code the condition as primary and this code as an optional secondary.

examples.quote: I want to discover affordable, healthy foods that will help me achieve my fitness and wellness goals.
What is the normal weight for a male who is 28 and five feet nine inches tall?
What impact (if any) has taking a GLP-1A medication had on your physical health?

codes.merge_note: All three passes had this code; pass 3 named it 'Nutrition, weight and fitness'. All three used the same three examples.

codes.name: Diabetes and hormones
codes.definition: The message asks about diabetes, blood sugar, or another hormone or metabolic condition. Includes A1c results, diabetes, hormone imbalance, seeing an endocrinologist, testosterone, and cholesterol.
signs: mentions diabetes, blood sugar, or an A1c value
asks about hormone imbalance or an endocrinologist
mentions testosterone or high cholesterol as a condition to manage
codes.how_it_differs: Diabetes and hormones covers hormone and metabolic conditions in general. Pregnancy and reproductive health covers pregnancy, labor, periods, and female reproductive organs. PCOS can fit either: if the message centres on periods, fertility, or other reproductive conditions (such as PMDD or endometriosis), use Pregnancy and reproductive health; if it centres on hormones, blood sugar, or cholesterol, use this code; use the other as secondary when both are present.

examples.quote: 72 yo woman with 6.0 a1c
Would an endocrinologist benefit me from learning why my hormones are our of whack?
what diabetes

codes.merge_note: Passes 1 and 3 kept hormone/metabolic conditions separate from reproductive health; pass 2 combined them in 'Hormones, diabetes and reproductive health'. Following the majority, the two are kept separate, and the pass 2 code is mapped here because most of its chats and examples are about diabetes and hormones. Its reproductive chats (endometriosis, labor) belong under Pregnancy and reproductive health.

codes.name: Eyes and vision
codes.definition: The message asks about the eyes or eyesight. Includes double vision, glasses, cataract surgery, and visits to eye doctors or retina specialists.
signs: mentions vision changes such as double vision
mentions glasses, an eye doctor, or a retina specialist
asks about cataracts or eye surgery
codes.how_it_differs: Eyes and vision is about the eyes themselves. Pain behind the eyes that comes with a headache or general illness goes to Headaches and nerve pain (or Infections and acute illness), not here.

examples.quote: Sometimes I'm not seeing double with my glasses on but sometimes I am.
My eye doctor is sending me to a retina specialist
Percentage of people need to get 2nd eye's cataract surgery after doing the first one.

codes.merge_note: All three passes had this code with the same name and the same three examples.

codes.name: Sleep and fatigue
codes.definition: The message asks about sleep problems or ongoing tiredness. Includes poor or unrefreshing sleep, waking at night, sleep apnea, sleep loss, and fatigue, including sleep changes linked to a medicine.
signs: asks about sleep apnea or snoring
waking during the night or trouble sleeping
feeling tired even after enough sleep
sleep changes after starting or changing a medicine
codes.how_it_differs: Sleep and fatigue covers sleep problems and tiredness as the main subject. If tiredness is one of several symptoms of a sudden flu-like illness, use Infections and acute illness. Stress, anxiety, and emotional struggles are not part of this code (see notes).

examples.quote: I've been feeling unusually tired lately, even after getting a full night's sleep.
What is sleep apnea? I think I may have it.
he's been waking a lot in the night and he never used to do that.

codes.merge_note: Passes 1 and 3 had 'Sleep and fatigue'; pass 2 combined sleep with mental health in 'Mental health and sleep'. Following the majority, the merged code covers sleep and fatigue only, and the pass 2 code maps here because most of its chats are about sleep. The mental health part (6a0206ae, 6929d658) was left uncoded by passes 1 and 3 as too rare; see notes.

codes.name: Headaches and nerve pain
codes.definition: The message asks about headaches or nerve pain. Includes headaches with or without other symptoms such as vomiting, and neuropathy or other pain described as coming from nerves.
signs: says they have a headache or asks what to take for one
headache with vomiting or pain behind the eyes
mentions neuropathy or nerve pain
codes.how_it_differs: Headaches and nerve pain covers headaches and pain named as nerve-related. Pain in a joint, muscle, back, or neck that is not described as nerve pain goes to Bones, joints and muscles. A headache that is one of several flu-like symptoms (fever, chills, body aches) goes to Infections and acute illness.

examples.quote: I have a headache, what should I take?
I have had an headache and vomitting for 2 days and pain behind my eyes
How to heal neuropathy pain in leg

codes.merge_note: Passes 1 and 2 had this code with the same name and examples. Pass 3 had no equivalent: it put the headache messages under Infections and acute illness and the neuropathy message under Bones, joints and muscles. Kept because it appears in 2 of 3 passes; it is small (about 3 chats).

codes.name: Pregnancy and reproductive health
codes.definition: The message asks about pregnancy, labor, menstruation, or the female reproductive organs. Includes labor and induction, periods, endometriosis, PCOS, and PMDD.
signs: mentions pregnancy, labor, or induction
mentions periods or menstrual symptoms
names a reproductive condition such as endometriosis, PCOS, or PMDD
codes.how_it_differs: Pregnancy and reproductive health covers pregnancy and the female reproductive system. Diabetes and hormones covers hormone and metabolic conditions not tied to reproduction (diabetes, A1c, cholesterol, general hormone imbalance). When a message lists both kinds of conditions, code the one it centres on as primary and the other as secondary.

examples.quote: Should you be drinking 3 weeks after endometriosis surgery and about to have your period?
I want to deal with my pcos, anemia, pmdd, and high cholesterol

codes.merge_note: Passes 1 and 3 had this as a separate code ('Pregnancy and reproductive health' and 'Women's reproductive health'); pass 2 folded it into its combined hormones code, which is mapped to Diabetes and hormones. Name from pass 1, which also covers pregnancy and labor. Only two clearly distinct chats provide quotes; 66aafcc3 (labor timing) is understood only through its context line.

notes: The three passes agreed closely: seven topics (bones/joints, digestion, skin/allergies, infections, diet/weight, eyes, hormones/diabetes) appeared in all three, usually with the same examples. Differences were about how to split: pass 2 combined reproductive health with hormones and mental health with sleep; pass 3 had no headache/nerve-pain code and widened digestion to kidneys and liver. The merge follows the majority in each case, so no pass code was dropped. Boundaries to watch in the pilot: (1) PCOS and lists of mixed conditions (69f4ca1a) between Diabetes and hormones and Pregnancy and reproductive health; (2) headaches between Headaches and nerve pain and Infections and acute illness, and limb neuropathy between Headaches and nerve pain and Bones, joints and muscles; (3) perianal abscess (5d7fd2a5) between Stomach and digestion and Infections and acute illness; (4) tiredness inside a flu-like illness vs Sleep and fatigue; (5) hair growth on a GLP-1 drug (69fe1811) between Skin, hair and allergies and Diet, weight and fitness. Messages without a fitting topic in two or more passes: greetings or one-word replies (6ae359af, 6a9bb385), chest pain on exercise (671a8337), kidney ultrasound report (6a638cf5), child development (69c41892), and stress/anxiety or family emotional struggles (6a0206ae, 6929d658). Mental health was coded only by pass 2 (inside its sleep code); the researcher may want to consider a separate Mental health and stress topic if more such messages appear in the full data. Very short or context-dependent messages (66aafcc3, 6a24b2df) were coded weakly by all passes.
